jobs.title: Commercial Analyst Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description
Commercial Analyst Development Program Manager
Job Summary

The Commercial Analyst Development Program Manager is responsible for the strategy, design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Huntington's Commercial Analyst Development Program. This role partners with Commercial Bank leaders, HR, Learning & Development, and University Relations to build a scalable early-career talent pipeline that develops job-ready analysts through structured training, rotational experiences, mentorship and career development.

Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and manage the Commercial Analyst Development Program
Partner with Commercial Bank leaders to align program curriculum, rotations and development experiences with business needs
Manage analyst onboarding, training schedules, rotations, communications, assessments and program operations
Facilitate relationships with analysts, managers, executives and program stakeholders
Measure and report on program effectiveness, including readiness, engagement, retention and promotion outcomes
Develop executive-level presentations, dashboards and business updates
Manage program budget, vendors and resources
Drive continuous improvement through feedback, data analysis and business partnership
Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or Human Resources

- 5+ years of career program management or commercial banking background.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Prior experience building structured development programs in alignment with business strategy

- Out-of-the-box thinker with a “roll-up the sleeves” attitude who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
- Organized and efficient with exceptional attention to detail; able to juggle a variety of projects and deliverables while also driving/supporting others toward shared outcomes
- Solid critical thinking skills - able to anticipate issues, adjust in the moment, and know when to raise hand for help
- Excellent interpersonal skills with an ability to effectively communicate with all stakeholders – from college student applicants to Executive-level Huntington leadership
- Management of budgets and building business proposals for program strategies
- Previous experience that included partnering with business segment and HR leaders
- Data acumen, with experience using data to inform and influence decision making
- Highly proficient in Office 365, including (Excel, Teams, PPT, and Word)
- Comfortable in a matrixed organization and in dealing with ambiguity

jobs.title: Commercial Relationship Manager III
jobs.description:
Description
Summary:
The Commercial Relationship Mgr III is responsible for building and servicing a sound and profitable portfolio of commercial business relationships and loans, and satisfying and exceeding customer needs and expectations, as well as credit and regulatory requirements, for originating and structuring Commercial loans. Originate, monitor and renew loan relationships consistent with the bank’s policies and procedures. Serves as the point person in determining the customer's needs and meeting them through the seamless delivery of the bank's products, services and associated resources. The RM will be responsible for working with companies with $50MM to $1B in annual revenue.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Originate, analyze, structure and close profitable loan transactions. Participate with more senior Relationship Managers on larger loans, and stay informed regarding the status of loans in the department.
- Maintain and confirm credit worthiness of customers. Gather, review and track appropriate documentation from applicants. Make decisions on loans and terms if within own lending limits.
- Participate in the underwriting of loan requests for new and existing customers. Due diligence would include verifying financial information provided, analyzing financial statements, conducting credit checks and assuring loan meets all policy and regulatory requirements.
- Serve existing accounts, review quarterly, semi-annual and annual findings for compliance and credit determination.  Recognize issues; early problem recognition, remedial management and appropriate coordination with workout is an important part of on-going portfolio management.
- Engage and provide direction to stakeholders including attorneys, accountants, consultants, appraisers, title companies, and necessary government agencies to ensure successful transactions.
- Provide guidance and direction to bank’s internal support personnel to ensure proper and accurate completion of loan transactions and day to day operational requirements.
- Promote and cross-sell other bank products and services as appropriate to customer requirements. Cross-sell banking services including business checking and treasury management products, and refer business or property owners to the branches for consumer deposit and loan products.
- Keep management fully informed on all key factors of the bank, the portfolio, client relationships, and the competitive environment.
- Performs all other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Finance/Accounting/Economics or banking/finance experience
- 6+ years of commercial lending experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Prior experience in negotiating, structuring, and closing complex commercial loan transactions.
- Strong analytical and credit skills.
- A high level of interpersonal and sales skills are necessary to compete effectively, present proposals to client, and recommend loan transactions to bank senior management.
- Thorough knowledge of various software programs including Word and Excel, and the ability to quickly learn additional systems/software.
- MBA in Finance or Accounting
- 8+ years of middle market lending experience
- Thorough knowledge of underwriting guidelines
- Prior experience underwriting complex commercial credits
- Legal documentation experience
- Knowledge of SBA and other similar government guarantee programs
- Strong analytical, interpersonal and organizational skills
- Highly developed oral and written communications and presentation skills

jobs.title: Senior Executive Relationship Manager - Middle Market, Texas
jobs.description:
Description
Job Description

Summary:
The Sr. Executive Relationship Manager prospects and develops upper middle market banking relationships targeting companies with revenues $50M and above within assigned geographic territory. They draw upon established network to drive bank / customer profitability via loans, deposits, Treasury Management, fees, and capital markets. They provide customers valuable insights and introduce product and service partners to meet customer needs. They work in concert with portfolio management partners, to structure loans, manage underwriting and credit approval process, ensure appropriate documentation, and manage closing of complex commercial loans.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Develops and deepens relationships with clients and prospective clients through consultative selling and introductions to appropriate bank partners in treasury management, capital markets, insurance, wealth and private banking, and retail banking.

- Leads team of cross functional colleagues in collaborative pre-call planning sessions resulting in robust client interactions.

- Leverages an established group of Centers of Influence to obtain referrals and continually works to grow this network.

- Ability to identify and mitigate credit risks, make recommendations on appropriate credit structure, and effectively articulate bank recommendation to clients and prospective clients.

- Adheres to bank policies and procedures and complies with legal and regulatory requirements.

- Follows processes and procedures to ensure risks are measured, monitored and controlled and compliance requirements are adhered to on an on-going basis.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in accounting, finance, or a related field.

- 15+ years related experience in financial services and banking with a focus on commercial banking relationships and knowledge

Preferred Qualifications:
- 20+ years’ experience working directly as a Commercial Relationship Manager.

- Demonstrated ability to develop a new market, create brand awareness and successfully generate meaningful new client relationships.

- Successful track record of recommending and cross selling important banking services including Treasury Management, Capital Markets, International Banking, Wealth Management, Private Banking, and Insurance to meet client needs and improve bank profitability.

- Formal credit training and commercial banking underwriting experience.

- Master of Business Administration Degree.

- Actively involved in community and/or non-profit volunteering services

- Ability to analyze corporate financial statements and make recommendations on credit structure.

- Strong written and verbal communication and negotiation skill set.

- Proficient with Microsoft Office products and ability and willingness to become proficient with critical proprietary systems.

- Knowledge in Capital Markets (Debt and Equity) and understand how to succeed in a multi-bank/syndicated credit facility environment.

- Disciplined and motivated self-starter who can manage business development efforts with minimal management oversight.

- Consistently exceed production targets in call activity, new client acquisition, funding loans, capital markets and other fees, liquidity/deposits, client-level and portfolio profitability.

jobs.title: E Commerce Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Description
Summary: The eCommerce Strategy Manager is responsible for driving measurable improvements in website performance, customer acquisition, and digital conversion through a data-driven optimization program. This helps with prioritization, execution, and measurement of website testing and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives across Huntington's digital properties. Leveraging customer insights, analytics, testing platforms, and industry best practices, the position partners closely with marketing, product, analytics, UX, content, and development teams to improve customer experiences and business outcomes. The role also supports the digital acquisition ecosystem through website, landing page, and Huntington.com experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Support the ongoing optimization of Huntington.com and related digital experiences through a structured Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) program.
- Identify customer experience opportunities using web analytics, behavioral data, customer feedback, competitive analysis, and industry best practices.
- Develop and maintain a testing roadmap focused on increasing acquisition, engagement, conversion rates, and customer satisfaction.
- Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests using Adobe Target/Sitecore Personalize and other optimization tools.
- Partner with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into measurable testing hypotheses and optimization initiatives.
- Utilize Adobe Analytics and other measurement tools to identify friction points, drop-off opportunities, and areas for performance improvement.
- Collaborate with UX, marketing, content, product, and development teams to implement and scale winning experiences.
- Develop, create, and publish website content and landing pages using Sitecore to support testing and acquisition initiatives.
- Support digital marketing campaigns across SEO, SEM, Email, Social, Display, Affiliate, Direct Mail, and other acquisition channels.
- Develop new experiences and page layouts using HTML/CSS to support experimentation and optimization efforts.
- Develop, schedule, and send emails using Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
- Ensure proper tagging, tracking, and measurement frameworks are implemented to support accurate test reporting and business insights.
- Act as an internal advocate for optimization, customer experience, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
- Ensure all website and email experiences comply with brand standards, accessibility requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
- Manage and prioritize multiple testing, optimization, and digital marketing initiatives simultaneously.
- Successfully collaborate within an agile, cross-functional environment.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- 3+ years of relevant Web content management and design experiences in Adobe Target/Sitecore Personalize/Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar applications.
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience developing and managing enterprise-level Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and experimentation programs.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies including A/B testing, multivariate testing, segmentation, and personalization.
- Experience developing testing strategies, roadmaps, hypotheses, and optimization frameworks.
- Demonstrated ability to turn web analytics and customer insights into actionable recommendations that improve business outcomes.
- Strong understanding of customer journey analysis, funnel optimization, and digital acquisition strategies.
- Strong understanding of Adobe Analytics and digital measurement frameworks.
- Strong understanding of Adobe Target, experimentation platforms, and website personalization.
- Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, customer acquisition, and digital marketing channels.
- Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and front-end optimization techniques.
- Strong understanding of content management systems (Sitecore / Sitecore XM / SitecoreAI).
- Strong understanding of website accessibility and digital best practices.
- Strong understanding of website tagging and analytics implementation.
- Experience presenting optimization results, business cases, and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Basic understanding and experience working in an agile environment.

jobs.title: Sr AI & Product Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Description
Summary:
The Sr AI & Product Transformation Manager is responsible for leading Huntington’s transition to a scalable product-based operating model while defining how artificial intelligence is embedded across the bank to accelerate growth, improve client outcomes, and increase operational efficiency.  While anchored in Technology, this role partners with business, product, and functional leaders to establish consistent standards, governance, prioritization, and value realization practices that align Technology execution to business and customer outcomes.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing transformation team responsible for strategy, design, execution, and enterprise adoption.
- Lead the product transformation strategy, for assigned product(s), shifting Technology from initiative-based delivery to a scalable product-based operating model.  Establish product operating model standards, including ownership, funding, staffing, intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, governance, cadence, and performance management.
- Lead AI strategy for assigned product (s) by driving workstreams around (1) AI Fluency including GenAI, Agent usage, model training, inference optimization, MCPs, and AI control needs, (2) AI Governance, (3) AI Platforms including reusable Agent capabilities, and (4) AI Enablement to accelerate implementations across segments.
- Partner with Technology, Data, Risk, Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and business leaders to ensure scalable, governed execution of product and AI transformation priorities.
- Define and track value realization measures, including speed to market, delivery efficiency, product performance, AI adoption, and measurable business outcomes, at the product level.
- Advise senior Technology and business leaders on product maturity, operating model effectiveness, AI enablement, and continuous improvement opportunities.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related, or equivalent education and experience
- Minimum 10 years of exp strategy, transformation, product management, technology, or a related and 3 years’ experience managing teams. Typically seeking 5 years’ experience managing teams.
- Experience leading large scale transformations through senior leader communication, assisting in defining product direction, and driving alignment across large, complex stakeholder groups.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, or equivalent).
- Experience with large scale product operating model transformations within Technology organizations.
- Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders across Technology and business product organizations to drive alignment and measurable outcomes.
- Solid understanding of modern product management, agile delivery, roadmap planning, lifecycle management, and outcome-based prioritization.
- Experience translating AI capabilities into practical business strategies, adoption models, and measurable value.
- Experience operating in highly regulated industries, with solid understanding of governance, risk, and compliance considerations.
- Strong ability managing and building a high performing team(s), and fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
- Strong demonstrated experience with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and O365.
- Proven ability shaping product strategy by aligning technology investments to business priorities, anticipating market shifts, and influencing leadership decisions.
- Experience delivering successfully in financial services or highly regulated industries.

jobs.title: Managing Director - International Corporate Banking
jobs.description:
Description
Summary:
As the Managing Director – International Banking, you will drive business growth and deepen relationships with internationally active clients, including U.S. subsidiaries of foreign-headquartered companies. This role partners across teams to support client needs, manage risk, and contribute to the success of International Banking and Corporate, Specialty & Government Banking.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities with internationally active clients and deliver coordinated banking solutions that meet client needs.
- Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with international banking clients and prospects, including clients with cross-border banking needs.
- Financial Management: Manage revenue, pricing, profitability, and portfolio performance for assigned client relationships.
- Risk Management: Work with internal partners to manage credit, country, regulatory, AML, sanctions, KYC, operational, and client-specific risks.
- Product and Solution Delivery: Partner with product teams to provide lending, trade finance, foreign exchange, treasury management, capital markets, liquidity, and related banking solutions.
- Market Intelligence: Monitor global market trends, currency movements, geopolitical developments, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and risks.
- Collaboration: Work across relationship management, product, credit, operations, compliance, risk, legal, and international teams to support consistent client coverage.
- Portfolio and Coverage Strategy: Support portfolio planning and coverage priorities for assigned clients and prospects.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree
- 7 or more years industry specific experience in a sales role including  building and maintain strong relationships with international banking clients
- FINRA Series 79 and 63 licenses, or ability to obtain within required timeframe

jobs.description:
Description
Capstone Partners is one of the largest and most active investment banking firms in the U.S. For over 20 years, Capstone Partners has been a trusted advisor to leading middle market companies, offering a fully integrated range of investment banking and financial advisory services uniquely tailored to help owners, investors, and creditors through each stage of the company's lifecycle. Capstone's services include M&A advisory, debt and equity placement, corporate restructuring, special situations, valuation and fairness opinions, and financial advisory services.

Headquartered in Boston, the firm has 250+ professionals in multiple offices across the U.S. With 12 dedicated industry groups, Capstone delivers sector-specific expertise through large, cross-functional teams. Capstone is a subsidiary of Huntington Bancshares Incorporated (NASDAQ: HBAN). For more information, visit www.capstonepartners.com .

Capstone is searching for two motivated professionals on our Industrials/Infrastructure team: Associate and/or Vice President. These roles are responsible for supporting the execution of middle-market mergers and acquisitions transactions, with a primary focus on sell-side advisory assignments. The Associate and VP levels play a critical part in transaction execution, financial analysis, valuation, client communications, marketing materials preparation, and managing due diligence processes. Each position works closely with senior bankers, clients, buyers, legal counsel, and other transaction participants to deliver successful outcomes for business owners and shareholders. The Vice President serves as the primary day-to-day contact for clients and transaction counterparties while both roles have responsibilities to oversee more junior level colleagues of the deal team.

Duties and Responsibilities:
Transaction Execution
- Manage day-to-day execution of sell-side M&A transactions from engagement through closing.
- Coordinate and track transaction milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
- Assist in third-party outreach and process management throughout marketing and due diligence phases.
- Facilitate communications among clients, prospective buyers, attorneys, accountants, lenders, and internal deal teams.
- Support negotiations by preparing analyses and transaction materials.

Financial Analysis & Valuation
- Build and maintain complex financial models, including: - Historical and projected operating models
- Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analyses
- Comparable company analyses
- Precedent transaction analyses
- Leveraged buyout (LBO) analyses

- Analyze company financial performance, market position, and growth opportunities.
- Assess transaction structures and financial implications for clients.

Marketing Materials Development
- Prepare confidential information memoranda (CIMs), management presentations, teasers, and buyer lists.
- Develop investment highlights and industry positioning analyses.
- Conduct industry, market, and competitive research.
- Assist in creating pitchbooks and business development presentations.

Due Diligence Management
- Coordinate due diligence processes and virtual data room activities.
- Review diligence requests and support management teams in preparing responses.
- Monitor buyer inquiries and ensure timely resolution of information requests.
- Identify and communicate potential transaction risks or issues.

Client Relationship Support
- Participate in client meetings, management presentations, and buyer meetings.
- Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the transaction process.
- Help prepare senior bankers for client discussions and negotiations.
- Deliver exceptional client service and professionalism.

Business Development Support (More for Vice President Level)
- Conduct industry and company research.
- Assist with sector coverage initiatives and market intelligence gathering.
- Support preparation of proposals and pitch presentations.
- Track and maintain target company and buyer databases.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.

- At least 3-5 years (varies per level) of investment banking, M&A advisory, valuation, transaction advisory services, corporate development, or private equity experience.

- Previous experience in elements of live sell-side M&A transactions.

- Strong accounting and financial statement analysis knowledge.
- Experience with Capital IQ, PitchBook, FactSet, or similar databases.

- Will be expected to hold or pass the FINRA Series 79 & 63 exams.

- Ability to pass an FBI (Federal Bureau of Investigations) background check, with fingerprinting, to be associated with the broker dealer.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced credentials are a plus.

- Advanced in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and CRM systems.
- Progressive financial modeling and valuation skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong project management and organizational skills.
- Professional presence and client-facing capabilities.
- Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to mentor junior professionals.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst 2
jobs.description:
Description
This role is only available onsite in our Schaumburg, IL office.

Summary
Huntington Distribution Finance, Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Treasury Analyst 2 to support daily treasury operations across multiple regions, including the U.S., Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. This role is responsible for cash forecasting, transaction processing, and maintaining accurate banking data to support efficient treasury management.

Responsibilities
- Run and leverage SAP Business Objects reports to determine the cash flow funding requirements.

- Perform daily cash reconciliation, analyzing ACH activity across Treasury’s banking platforms and HDFs Operating System; investigate and resolve discrepancies.

- Prepare daily cash forecasts and determine required funding levels.

- Process daily ETOP withdrawals and payments (transfer funds between internal and external Huntington General Ledgers or Demand Deposit Accounts).

- Prepare Intercompany BOL Book Transfers from Parent account to settle business unit funding needs.

- Execute approved Wire, ACH, and FX transactions in Huntington BOL (treasury banking platform) and JPMorgan Chase Access platforms.

- Process customer requests to add or change banking instructions; required to verify, input, and maintain customer banking details from Bank Authorization Forms.

- Manage ACH rejects and U.S. returned checks, ensuring timely communication to business units.

- Create and maintain Wire, ACH, and FX templates in treasury banking platforms.

- Prepare daily reporting for U.S. Canada, Australia and New Zealand market indices and foreign exchange rates by accessing various internet site that provides the rates.

- Support additional treasury tasks and special projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor degree or finance/banking experience
- 5+ years of treasury, cash management, or related financial experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

- Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently in a fast paced, deadline driven environment.

- Proficiency with treasury/banking platforms (BOL, ETOP, JPMorgan Chase Access) preferred.

This role is only available onsite in our Schaumburg, IL office

jobs.description:
Description
Summary:
The analyst supports the CSG Credit Products team and ongoing portfolio management and underwriting activities.  In this entry level role, the analyst will develop skills in credit and market analysis including cash flow analysis and modeling, capitalization, industry research, credit policy and legal documentation, among others, in analyzing and summarizing the creditworthiness of clients and prospects.  The Analyst will generally support the Credit Products Portfolio Management team and will also collaborate with internal partners including Relationship Management, Credit Administration, Capital Markets, and others in creating such analysis. The Analyst position is an entry-level developmental role for colleagues seeking a career in Portfolio Management; but may also be constructive for a colleague seeking a path to Relationship Management, Credit, Capital Markets, or many other Commercial roles within the Bank.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Gather and analyze financial and business information to determine creditworthiness for loan and credit products.
- Complete financial spreads, risk rating, performance tearsheets, compliance testing, and other portfolio monitoring & maintenance activities
- Underwrite complex commercial loans in accordance with Huntington credit policies.  This may include financial statement analysis, collateral analysis, financial modeling, industry and business risk evaluation and management assessment.
- Conduct industry and market research using numerous resources available; distilling key themes and conclusions into concise summary form for presentation purposes.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree required (Finance, Accounting, or related field)
- High level of attention to detail
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (particularly Microsoft Excel)

Description

The Data Management Operations Lead is responsible for delivering high-quality data services and operational support for the enterprise, with a high level of technical skills.

-  Works with business partners and team to understand requirements for data use, analysis, and quality.  Maintains knowledge of the legal, compliance and regulatory issues impacting data.

jobs.description:
Description
Summary :

Huntington’s internship programs provide emerging talent with meaningful, hands ‑ on experience aligned to their area of study. Over the course of the interns’ time at Huntington, they gain exposure to key business functions across all segments of the organization. An intern’s experience should be focused on professional growth, skill development, and practical application of academic learning. Interns participate in a structured series of development opportunities, including interactions with senior leadership and career pathing insights. The experience also includes immersion in Huntington’s award ‑ winning culture through community involvement and team ‑ based activities. Internships at Huntington are designed to help students build a strong foundation for future career success while contributing to meaningful business initiatives.

Internship Opportunities at Huntington:

Huntington offers internship opportunities for students who are currently enrolled in an academic program and seeking practical, hands ‑ on experience in their field of study.   Internships take place during a defined period of time and are available across all business segments.

- Rising seniors ( Winter 2027 or Spring 2028 grads ) may participate in the Enterprise Internship Program , an 11-week , role-aligned experience where students work directly with a manager and team on meaningful business initiatives. In addition to hands-on project work, participants gain exposure to executive leadership, participate in Huntington's innovation project, and build connections that may lead to future full-time opportunities.

All i nterns participate in a variety of developmental and professional activities designed to support learning and exposure to the organization. Depending on your school year , p rogram components may include:
